Scaffold

In HongKong, wood material using is unlegal, but which interesting is that there were many scafford in Shanghai Street is made by bamboo instead of metal. In many's impression, bamboo is more simple as a sort of temporary constraction material in Hong Kong. And for the under area using in operation, they touch a little area in the ground, but bigger than the size of building in gerenal in upper area.

Garden 

The garden under the big banyan tree has become a community center. The elderly passersby and children can sit here. They are not bored with pedestrians who can come and go, thus becoming unintentional watchers. They are also landscapes. This forms a good public space.

Growing Up System

The building grows from the roots and expands on the upper part to form a large mushroomshaped
body that occupies the sky-viewing area.
